heroHeadline: Far-Right Espriella Wins First Round; June 21 Runoff Against Cepeda Confirmed
heroSubtitle: Abelardo de la Espriella (far-right) topped the May 31 presidential first round, defeating front-runner polling expectations and advancing to a June 21 runoff against left-wing candidate Iván Cepeda. The result ends the Petro era and sets a polarizing battle over Total Peace, the 2016 FARC accords, and Colombia's economic direction.
footerNote: Data sourced from the Colombian Truth Commission (CEV), JEP, INDEPAZ, InSight Crime, ICRC, Human Rights Watch, UNODC, MOE (Electoral Observation Mission), Ecopetrol, and major international outlets.
